name: p67_battery_extra_draw_size

ownership.argument: Borrowed live battery object, validated through the current native Control Center parent chain or owned synchronous draw dispatch.
ownership.return_value: Scalar extra drawing extent; no ownership transfer.

provenance.source: Exact .043 read-only native ABI audit: AP extra-draw-size getter thunk; snapshot 0x1c06030c obtains the extent from object spec_attr+44.

notes: Battery constructor sets object+68=30; REFRESH_EXT_DRAW_SIZE event22 supplies that extent. Default 62x32 battery therefore snapshots to 122x92, not 64x36. Re-read current extent and geometry after snapshot layout. NOT_PROBED; no range expansion.
